layoutPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ground-only game terrain planning plate for The Lantern Atlas. Image 1 is the EXISTING NORTH NEIGHBOR and a style/scale reference, not an edit target. Create only the NEW terrain immediately SOUTH of it. Output landscape 1536x1024 representing 768x512 world units. The output TOP edge joins the reference BOTTOM edge: olive grass from x0 to 240 world units, warm small-cobble road from x240 to 490, grass from x490 to 768, and thin low curbs at exactly those two road edges. Continue this north entrance down into a welcoming community garden court. A broad accessible cobbled loop curves around a low central grassy garden bed, with an open paved greenhouse forecourt on the right. A 90-world-unit-wide branch exits the LEFT edge centered at y285 for a future quay connection; another broad road exits the BOTTOM edge centered at x415, width150. Right edge stays mainly garden grass. No stairs, steep walls, water or inaccessible terraces. Make a connected clear public circulation route, several small low rectangular soil beds, and flat open lots for separate editable greenhouse, benches, trees and a fountain. Raised objects must NOT be painted into the terrain. Match the reference's elevated orthographic/isometric camera without horizon, tiny cream/honey and gray cobbles, warm daylight, painterly detail, delicate grass and granular soil. This new tile should have its own garden-loop composition, not repeat the crossroad of the reference. Frame is filled edge to edge with ground. No buildings, tall plants, trees, furniture, crates, lamps, vehicles, people, signs, letters, text, labels, grid, border or UI. No shadows from absent objects. Exact road-edge registration and consistent paving scale are essential. Only the new SOUTH tile in the output; do not include any of the existing north neighbor.
revisions: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this terrain planning plate ONLY in the upper road entrance. The canvas is 1536x1024. At the TOP edge move the road's LEFT curb to exactly x480 (31.25% of width) and its RIGHT curb to exactly x980 (63.80% of width). The entire space between x480 and x980 at the top must be continuous warm cobbled pavement, not grass. Keep these curbs vertical for the first 50 pixels then smoothly merge with the existing left and right path curves by y275. This widens and slightly recenters the current top entrance so it joins an existing north neighbor. Preserve ALL terrain below y275 exactly, including the central grassy oval, side garden beds, west path and bottom road. Preserve the image size, view, stone scale, textures and daylight. No new objects or text. Output the whole corrected terrain, same framing, no crop.

daySectionPrompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: high-resolution ground source for The Lantern Atlas, garden-court daylight section 0-0. Image 1 is the EXACT GEOMETRY EDIT TARGET and fills the entire output. Redraw at approximately 1494 by 1052 native pixels, preserving the exact 432:304 aspect ratio. It represents exactly 432 by 304 world units. Produce at least 1450x1024 native pixels. Paint fresh fine detail in every small cobble, mortar joint, hairline stone crack, delicate grass blade, granular soil and low garden-bed curb. Match the existing small paving-stone scale and warm cream/honey/gray palette; do not enlarge stones. Keep EVERY existing road edge, low curb, grass boundary, soil bed and edge intersection at exactly the same normalized positions. No crop, zoom, rotation, changed camera or shifted geometry. Four overlapping registered sections will be stitched, so edge registration is critical. Calm daylight; detailed painterly game art, not photo noise or blur. Ground only: no buildings, trees, tall foliage, furniture, crates, lamps, vehicles, people, letters, symbols, text, border, UI, or shadows from absent objects. Output only the finished section.
